samples.summary: Gate 1's identity check lost all behavioral coverage; the process-level stub was loosened so a regression to the unscoped query would keep the suite green
samples.evidence: This delta deletes the three process-level tests that proved gate 1 rejects a forged/foreign workflow run ("gate 1 reads the CI WORKFLOW FILE", "gate 1 is not forgeable by a SECOND workflow file…", and the @ref test) and simultaneously removes the `path` filter from `ciConclusion` (checks.mjs:117 now does `newestRun(workflowRuns || [])`). The whole identity guarantee now rests on the URL mark-ready sends, but the stub `gh` matches any api call containing `/runs?head_sha=` (mark-ready.test.mjs:67) and returns the fixture regardless — so nothing in mark-ready.test.mjs observes which URL was requested, even though `calls`/`tokenCalls` already record it. If mark-ready.mjs reverted to `repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs?head_sha=…`, every process-level test still passes AND a forged newest run would now be accepted, because ciConclusion no longer filters. The only remaining defense is the source-text grep in checks.test.mjs:537-549, i.e. a regex over the file rather than an observation of behavior. A one-line `assert.match(calls.find(c=>c.startsWith("api")), /actions\/workflows\/ci\.yml\/runs/)` would restore behavioral coverage of the guard this whole change exists to strengthen.

samples.summary: set-state.mjs's changed CI-runs query has no behavioral test at all — only a source-text grep
samples.evidence: gatherSignals now issues `/actions/workflows/${CI_WORKFLOW_FILE}/runs?head_sha=` (set-state.mjs:229-233) and feeds the unfiltered result to `ciConclusion`, which no longer checks identity. `scripts/agent/set-state.test.mjs` contains no gh stub and no reference to `gatherSignals`, `actions/`, `head_sha` or `workflow_runs` (grepped; zero matches) — only `deriveState` unit cases. So the only thing pinning set-state's half of the change is the regex over its source in checks.test.mjs:537-549. A malformed URL (wrong placeholder, missing `head_sha`) that still matched that regex would ship unnoticed; the visible cost is a wrong lifecycle label, so contained.

samples.summary: The scoping test enumerates callers by hand, so a future third caller of ciConclusion is unguarded now that the function no longer filters by path
samples.evidence: `ciConclusion` used to enforce identity itself (`ciRunsFor`), which protected every caller by construction; the enforcement now lives at call sites and is tested by a hardcoded list `for (const file of ["mark-ready.mjs", "set-state.mjs"])` (checks.test.mjs:537). Nothing derives that list from who actually imports/calls `ciConclusion`, so a new reader that fetches `actions/runs?head_sha=` and passes the result in reopens the forgery hole with a fully green suite. Deriving the file list by grepping scripts/agent for `ciConclusion(` would make the test self-maintaining.

verdict.reason: The finding's blocking premise — "a regression to the unscoped query would keep the suite green" / the guard has no test left that fails on it — is false. scripts/agent/checks.test.mjs:520-553 is a live test that, for BOTH mark-ready.mjs and set-state.mjs (loop at line 537), asserts the source contains `actions/workflows/${CI_WORKFLOW_FILE}/runs?head_sha=` (539-543), asserts it does NOT contain `actions/runs?head_sha=` (544-547), forbids `split("@")` path parsing (548), and pins CI_WORKFLOW_FILE === "ci.yml" (551-552). That suite executes in CI: scripts/verify-self.mjs:160 runs `node --test` over every *.test.mjs under scripts/agent. So the exact revert the finding describes (mark-ready going back to `repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs?head_sha=`) fails the suite at a named assertion, and it is pinned for set-state too, which no process-level mark-ready test ever covered. I independently confirmed the narrow factual part of the finding — mark-ready.test.mjs's stub (line 67) matches any `/runs?head_sha=` call and no test inspects `calls`/`tokenCalls` for the scoped path, and checks.mjs:116-120 no longer filters by `path` — but with the regression already guarded by an executed test, the request for an additional runtime URL assertion is "coverage could be stronger / add more tests", which this lens's rubric excludes from blocking. Ground: already-guarded.
